"Karen, you look awful. You sleep, you get to go see Mr. Smith, he likes that.  Look, I can tell that look in your eye. You're going to cry, I know you are. You know, that look, it scares me. It scares me a lot. What you do with it, you do with it, but look at me, I don', know. I know you do not like it, but some people are better off dead, you know? Maybe you do what they are doing, then you do not have to see it any more.  then it will all go away.  Just go out there and do it.  Go on, go. Go out and do it."

Karen sat up straight, her hand to her mouth, she was sick. That look, she does not see that look any more.  What do you think he means? It don' talk, but I know what it means. it means the things that happen in the night in the dark. It means I am going to do it. It means you know that, too. Yes, I know that.

"Come on now, get up and go. You don' have to do it now, but go and get some supper. You are thin. You look like a little cat, a sick cat. Go and sleep, and then go and do it. You know what to do."

Karen stand up, her legs are all a-shake, but she stand up. She go to the sink, and she wash her face.  Then she go and say goodnight to Mrs. Smith.

But they go to take her to the car, and he does it, he does it to her.

I know him. I know what he is. He's a bad man. He's going to do that to more people.
